verdict.rationale: Thoropass's docs show core SOC 2 program building blocks — Unified Controls mapped across frameworks, policy creation/publish workflows, evidence requests, continuous Monitors, access reviews, and Risk Register — which together support running a SOC 2 program end to end. However, none of the evidence explicitly names Trust Services Criteria or distinguishes Type I vs Type II workflow support. Missing for 10: explicit Trust Services Criteria control mapping, explicit Type I vs Type II program distinction/workflow documentation, independent customer corroboration of full SOC 2 lifecycle completion.
